arithmetic.explanation: Of the 7 ayat carrying a repeated topicId, 6 carry ONLY that one distinct topic (22:27, 22:28, 22:29, 22:33, 22:34 hajj-rites; 2:184 ramadan-fasting). Those 6 are NOT multi-topic under the distinct-topic definition, but ARE counted by a raw occurrence-based definition. The 7th ayah (17:23) has 3 distinct topics, so it is already inside the 230. Therefore raw multi-topic ayat = 230 + 6 = 236, and 236 - 7 = 229 is an INVALID subtraction because only 6 of the 7 duplicates lie outside the 230 set.
arithmetic.invalidHistoricalSubtraction: 236 - 7 = 229 (does not equal 230; the operands describe different sets)

defectiveMethodologiesReproduced.conclusion: Both are methodology defects. Neither indicates a change in production data.

rangeKeyGrouping.description: Groups by surahNumber:ayahStart-ayahEnd, treating each distinct range as a separate unit instead of expanding to individual ayat.

startKeyOnly.description: Groups by surahNumber:ayahStart, ignoring ayahEnd. Under-counts ayat covered by ranges that start elsewhere.

fieldDocumentation.canonicalMethod: Full range expansion: each mapping contributes one occurrence per ayah in [ayahStart, ayahEnd]; identity = surahNumber:ayah.
fieldDocumentation.distinctTopicCount: Number of distinct topicIds covering this ayah.
fieldDocumentation.duplicateOccurrenceCount: Sum of excess occurrences across all ayat (same topic counted twice on one ayah).
fieldDocumentation.occurrenceCount: Number of mapping occurrences covering this ayah (ranges expanded).
fieldDocumentation.repeatedTopicIds: topicIds occurring more than once for this ayah, with excess = occurrences - 1.
